checks.question: Revise the supplied hollow T connector. The unchanged vertical main tube has outside diameter 24 mm, inside diameter 16 mm and height 50 mm, bottom at Z=0. Its horizontal branch axis runs along positive X at Y=0,Z=25. Extend that branch so its end face moves from X=30 to X=42 mm; increase its outside diameter from 20 to 24 mm and its bore from 12 to 16 mm. The branch must remain fused to the main tube, with an open passage into the vertical bore and no membrane at the junction. From the new branch end, add a concentric diameter-20 mm socket recess 6 mm deep. At X=26,Z=25, add two opposite diameter-4 mm radial holes parallel to Y, each through the branch wall into its bore. Preserve both ends of the main tube, its inner and outer cylindrical surfaces away from the branch junction, and the original pose and material. The three original flow outlets and the two new radial holes must all communicate through real hollow geometry.；按本题允许修改范围检查形态或照明变化，N中已计的尺寸/数量不在此重复计分。
